::: {#def-linear-regression}
#### Linear regression model

A **linear regression model** is a homoskedastic (@def-homoskedastic)
conditional Gaussian model (@def-cond-gaussian)
whose mean function is linear in $p$ covariates,
where observation $i$ has covariate values
$\vpredvar_\iobs = (\predvar_{\iobs 1}, \ldots, \predvar_{\iobs p})$:

$$\mean(x_1, \ldots, x_p) \eqdef \intcoef + \sumjp \coef{x_j} x_j.$$

Source: @wikipedia_linear_regression.
:::
